notes.title: It is recommended to disable [Steam Input] for gamepad operation.
notes.content: There may be issues with some gamepad operations.

notes.title: Ver2.2 release
notes.content:
Changes:

-Changed the specifications of some bosses.

-Added an option to enable/disable full-screen mode from [OPTIONS].

-Added an option to change the screen size from [OPTIONS].

-Added an option to show/hide the hitbox of the player's character. (Controller Select (Back) button, keyboard Q).
